doctrine: Training evidence must distinguish a reusable implementation from an exact artifact campaign. Verify production workflows at their real objective, device, data, persistence, and lifecycle scope. Every admitted objective must prove uninterrupted/split equivalence and atomic checkpoint identity. A successful GUI run must publish a trace and an evaluation-required decision; promotion remains withheld until held-out evidence exists. Committed training specifications identify the exact model, dataset, commit, span, measurements, and evidence bytes, and a generated matrix exposes their strongest claims without upgrading smoke evidence. Missing model artifacts remain explicit verification gaps, never passes.

items.title: Verify exact resume for every production training objective

steps.title: Compare uninterrupted and split token, DPO, and GRPO workflow executions
steps.rationale: A checkpoint claim is operational only when weights, optimizer state, dataset position, observations, and identity survive a workflow-level split.

items.title: Verify the train to evaluation boundary

steps.title: Prove GUI training publishes checkpoint, trace, and evaluation-required decision without premature promotion
steps.rationale: Successful optimization is not promotion evidence; the durable handoff must retain rollback authority until a held-out evaluator decides.

items.title: Expose production training scope without fallback claims

steps.title: Verify objective, device, model, and GUI admission boundaries from executable owners
steps.rationale: The release must distinguish token, DPO, and GRPO production routes from compiled-only objectives, host-only preference optimization, host-only MoE, and artifact-specific probes.
